namespace = cc_xp

###############################################################################
# GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand.
#   python tools/generate_ladders.py
#
# CHOOSING A CAREER. One event per track, opened from that track's training return
# event when the minister who came back holds no ladder trait at all. This is the
# only way onto rung 0 that the player controls, and the only way at all onto the
# four ladders no event in the mod grants the entry trait for.
#
#   cc_xp.90   [adm] 4 of 6: reform, fiscal, learning, urbanism, law, integration
#   cc_xp.91   [dip] 4 of 5: envoy, colonial, trade, exploration, intrigue
#   cc_xp.92   [mil] 3 of 4: command, drill, siege, cavalry
#
# THE MENU IS PARTIAL. Each opening shows a rotating window of the track's careers,
# rolled by cc_xp_offer_career_<track> at the moment the minister got back, so the
# court is offering what it can rather than presenting a catalogue. Every option is
# gated on that roll; the first also passes when the roll is somehow unset, which is
# the guard against an event with no available option and therefore no way to close
# it.
#
# There is no decline option, for the same reason the events in cc_xp_choice_events
# have none: the training that opened this was already paid for.
#
# The minister is identified by a timed flag rather than a saved scope, as
# everywhere else in this system. Two ministers back from the same posting in the
# same month resolve to different people, because selection clears the flag.
###############################################################################


# ADM
cc_xp.90 = {
	type = country_event
	title = cc_xp.90.title
	desc = cc_xp.90.desc
	outcome = positive

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = interior
	}

	trigger = {
		any_character = { has_variable = cc_xp_awaiting_career_adm }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_xp_awaiting_career_adm }
			remove_variable = cc_xp_awaiting_career_adm
			save_scope_as = cc_xp_subject
		}
	}

	# The Reformer's Path -> fumbling_reformist
	option = {
		name = cc_xp.90.a
		trigger = {
			scope:cc_xp_subject ?= {
				NOT = { has_trait_category = cabinet }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = cc_xp_career_offer }
					OR = {
						var:cc_xp_career_offer = 1
						var:cc_xp_career_offer = 4
						var:cc_xp_career_offer = 5
						var:cc_xp_career_offer = 6
					}
				}
				# The roll is unset only if the write did not commit. Fall back to
				# offering everything this person is actually eligible for.
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
		}
		scope:cc_xp_subject ?= {
			set_variable = { name = cc_granting_trait  value = yes }
			add_trait = trait:fumbling_reformist
			remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = cc_xp_career_offer }
				remove_variable = cc_xp_career_offer
			}
		}
	}
